name: productos
description: ProductOS — a complete operating system for taking a product from idea to revenue with AI agents. Installs inside your app repo as productos/, optionally ships with a coach-composed programme plan, and runs four phases (Define, Design, Develop, Distribute), each with checklists, worksheets, and 39 skills that write every output to your repo's docs/ folder.

interface.shortDescription: From idea to revenue with AI agents
interface.longDescription: ProductOS guides you through four phases — Define, Design, Develop, Distribute — each with checklists, worksheets, and skills. Your AI agent does the heavy lifting; the system keeps it honest, and every output lands in your repo's docs/ folder — one source of truth for your offer, design, build plan, and growth.
